description: Electronic Spices 84mm x61mm 6V 100mAh Rectangle Shaped Polycrystalline Mini Epoxy Solar Panels (Pack of 10) - Distributed/Packaged by Electronic Spices. Product Details: This is a mini solar panel. It consumes sunlight to produce electricity directly. It does not need any special equipment. Just put this device in the sun's ray, and the board is ready to produce electricity. This is light in weight and can also be a place where space is an issue because it does not take much space either. This mini device produces 6 volts of electricity. Because of its excellent design and high electricity production, it is very popular in solar DIY projects. So, if you want an unlimited source of electricity, then this might be the right choice for you. The solar panel utilizes polycrystalline photovoltaic cells, which are known for their high overall performance and durability. These cells are made from multiple silicon crystals, providing dependable overall performance in both direct and oblique daylight conditions. The solar panel generates a stable output voltage of 6 volts (6V), making it suitable for charging and powering devices and components that require this voltage level. This voltage output is well suited to an extensive range of electronic programs, consisting of small-scale solar-powered systems and projects.
